rubrics.subject: ICT

concepts.name: CPU components and functions

points.text: The arithmetic and logic unit performs arithmetic calculations and logical operations.
The control unit directs or coordinates computer operations.
Registers temporarily hold data or intermediate results used during processing.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: RAM and ROM

points.text: RAM temporarily holds working data and loses its contents when power is removed.
ROM retains its contents without power and stores startup instructions.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Purpose of cache memory

points.text: Cache is a small, fast memory that holds frequently needed data.
It reduces access time by making those data readily available to the CPU instead of repeatedly fetching them from RAM.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Secondary storage

points.text: Secondary storage keeps data for later use and retains them when power is removed.
An appropriate secondary storage example is identified, such as a hard disk, optical disc or flash drive.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme. Use this criterion only when an explanation AND an example are required.

concepts.name: Main roles of an operating system

points.text: An operating system is system software that manages hardware and other software or resources.
It provides an interface through which a user interacts with the computer.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Operating system process management

points.text: A process is a running program or an executing part of a program.
The operating system schedules processes or allocates CPU time so tasks can execute in an appropriate order.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Operating system memory management

points.text: The operating system allocates suitable RAM space to running processes.
It releases or makes that space available again when a process finishes.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Internet and World Wide Web

points.text: The Internet is an interconnected collection of computer networks.
The World Wide Web is a service using the Internet that provides linked web pages or documents accessed through a browser.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Purpose of DNS

points.text: DNS resolves a human-readable domain name to an IP address.
The resulting address is used to locate or connect to the requested server.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.

concepts.name: Email Cc and Bcc

points.text: Cc sends additional copies of an email to named recipients.
Bcc also sends copies, while hiding Bcc recipient addresses from recipients in To and Cc.

concepts.scopeNote: Assess the explicitly selected criteria only; not an official marking scheme.
